message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on modular sectional seating components with wooden frames, upholstered. Seats with wooden frames, upholstered, fall under 9401.61.40 (other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered) or 9401.61.60 (other). In the HTSUS, 9401.61.40 is "Upholstered: Other seats, with wooden frames: Convertible into beds, other than those of 9401.40" - actually 9401.61.20 covers "Seats of a kind used for ... " Let me recall the structure:

9401.61 – Other seats, with wooden frames: Upholstered.
- 9401.61.20: Seats of a kind used for aircraft... Actually 9401.61.20 is "Theater seats, church seats..." in older versions, which changed later.
- 9401.61.40: Other: Chairs ... "Seats, other than chairs, designed for the home"? The current structure is 9401.61.40 "Other: Convertible into beds"? I recall 9401.61.40.31 / 9401.61.60.31 etc.

Current HTSUS: 9401.61.20 00 Theater seats, church seats and similar; 9401.61.40 00 "Other: Seats, ... Not elsewhere specified"? In my recollection, 9401.61.40 is "Other, with wooden frames: Other... Chairs" and 9401.61.60 is "Other" with 9401.61.6011 for "Other: Stuffed with ...". Commonly used for sofas: 9401.61.6011 "Other seats, upholstered, wooden frames, Other: Stuffed or ..."? Rulings on sectional sofas cite 9401.61.6011 ("Other: Other: Other: Stuffed/Other"). I recall 9401.61.6011 being used for upholstered wooden-framed seats, "Other, Other, Other: Other". I'll go with 9401.61.6011.
